description: Current source_diagnostics::function_warnings walks guards and bodies and checks case/with, but does not analyze surface.clauses/function params. Acceptance: partial multi-clause fn heads emit type/no-matching-clause through production source diagnostics; tree.fz reports its expected warning; total multi-clause functions remain clean; cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
title: Source diagnostics warn on partial multi-clause function heads
